question: Which Article of the Constitution authorises issuing of writs by any High Court of the country?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Article 226**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 226** of the Indian Constitution empowers every **High Court** in India to issue writs for the enforcement of fundamental rights and other legal rights.
 
• The writs include **Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari,** and **Quo-Warranto.**
